主題：讓新進同事第一週就能自己找到資料
text.en:
Date: 4 March 2026    By: J. R. Lin
Topic: Let new hires find things on their own in week one

text.zhHant:
新人平均要問 11 次才找得到報價單範本。問的人耗時，被問的人被打斷，
而且每個人被教到的版本都不一樣。
text.en:
New hires ask around 11 times before they find the quotation template.
It costs them time, it interrupts everyone else, and each of them ends up
with a slightly different version.

text.zhHant:
一、把範本收進共用資料夾，並在入職清單上寫明路徑。
二、錄一段 5 分鐘的螢幕操作，放進新人信裡。
三、改讓範本從 App 內直接建立，不必找檔案。
text.en:
1. Put the templates in one shared folder and name the path in the checklist.
2. Record a five-minute screen walkthrough and attach it to the welcome mail.
3. Create the templates from inside the app so nobody has to find a file.

text.zhHant:
先做第三個 —— 前兩個都還是要人記得去找，第三個不必。
負責：佳蓉　　回報：3 月 11 日週會

Start with (3): the first two still rely on someone remembering to look.

text.zhHant:
題目：質量 m = 12 kg 的箱子放在傾角 θ = 25° 的斜面上，
靜摩擦係數 μs = 0.35。問：箱子會不會自己滑下來？
text.en:
Problem: a 12 kg box rests on a 25° incline with a static friction
coefficient of 0.35. Will it start to slide on its own?

text.zhHant:
沿斜面向下：F∥ = m·g·sinθ = 12 × 9.81 × sin25° = 49.75 N
垂直斜面：N = m·g·cosθ = 12 × 9.81 × cos25° = 106.69 N
text.en:
Along the slope: F∥ = m·g·sinθ = 12 × 9.81 × sin25° = 49.75 N
Normal to the slope: N = m·g·cosθ = 12 × 9.81 × cos25° = 106.69 N

text.zhHant:
臨界角 θc = arctan(μs) = arctan(0.35) = 19.3°。
題目的 25° 大於臨界角，與上面的結論一致。
text.en:
Critical angle θc = arctan(μs) = arctan(0.35) = 19.3°.
25° exceeds it, which agrees with the result above.

text.zhHant: 課堂筆記：現金流量表怎麼讀
text.en: Class Notes: Reading a Cash Flow Statement

text.zhHant:
課程：財務報表分析（三）　　講者：黃振庭 教授
日期：2026 年 3 月 12 日　　第 5 週
text.en:
Course: Financial Statement Analysis III    Lecturer: Prof. C. T. Huang
Date: 12 March 2026    Week 5

text.zhHant: 重點一：三張表要一起看
text.en: Key 1: the three statements only make sense together

text.zhHant:
損益表講的是「賺不賺錢」，現金流量表講的是「收不收得到錢」。
帳上有獲利卻倒閉的公司，問題幾乎都出在後者。
text.en:
The income statement says whether a company is profitable; the cash flow
statement says whether the money actually arrives. Companies that fail
while showing a profit almost always fail on the second one.

text.zhHant: 重點二：營業活動現金流是體質
text.en: Key 2: operating cash flow is the health check

text.zhHant:
連續兩年營業活動現金流小於淨利，要去看應收帳款與存貨 ——
通常是東西賣出去了但錢還沒收回來，或根本還堆在倉庫。
text.en:
If operating cash flow trails net income for two years running, look at
receivables and inventory: the goods left the shelf but the cash did not
arrive, or they never left at all.

text.zhHant:
・自由現金流 = 營業活動現金流 − 資本支出
・間接法的調整項要會自己推一次
・期末作業用真實公司的年報，不能用課本範例
text.en:
- Free cash flow = operating cash flow - capital expenditure
- Be able to derive the indirect-method adjustments unaided
- Final assignment must use a real annual report, not a textbook case

text.zhHant: 利息支出為什麼放在營業活動而不是籌資活動？下週問或查 IFRS。
text.en:
Why does interest paid sit under operating rather than financing?
Ask next week, or look it up in IFRS.

text.zhHant: 康乃爾筆記：注意力機制
主題：Transformer 的注意力機制　　日期：2026 年 3 月 18 日
text.en: Topic: attention in the Transformer    Date: 18 March 2026

text.zhHant: 提示欄（左）：之後用這些問題自我測驗
text.en: Cue column: questions to self-test with later

text.zhHant:
・Q、K、V 各自代表什麼？
・為什麼要除以 √d_k？
・多頭注意力比單頭多了什麼？
text.en:
- What do Q, K and V each stand for?
- Why divide by the square root of d_k?
- What does multi-head attention add over a single head?

text.zhHant: 筆記欄（右）：上課當下記的內容
text.en: Note column: what was said in class

text.zhHant:
注意力就是「用一個查詢去問一整排鍵，算出每一個值該佔多少權重」。
除以 √d_k 是為了讓內積的變異數不隨維度長大，否則 softmax 會飽和、
梯度趨近於零。多頭是把同一段輸入投影到多組子空間各算一次，
讓不同的頭去抓不同的關係（語法、指代、距離）。
text.en:
Attention asks one query against a row of keys and works out how much
weight each value should carry. The square-root term keeps the variance
of the dot product from growing with dimension; without it softmax
saturates and the gradient vanishes. Multiple heads project the same
input into several subspaces so different heads can pick up different
relations - syntax, coreference, distance.

text.zhHant: 總結欄（下）：用自己的話寫兩句
text.en: Summary: two sentences in your own words

text.zhHant:
注意力讓每個位置自己決定要看誰，而不是照固定的順序讀。
縮放與多頭都是為了讓這件事在深層網路裡還算得穩。
text.en:
Attention lets every position choose what to look at instead of reading
in a fixed order. Scaling and multiple heads are what keep that stable
once the network gets deep.

text.en: Shot: 9 February 2026, 05:52    35 mm, f/8, 1/125 s, ISO 200

text.zhHant:
漁船放在右上交點，船頭朝畫面左側 —— 視線進來之後往左走，
剛好被左下的纜繩接住，不會直接滑出畫面。
text.en:
The boat sits on the upper-right intersection with its bow facing left, so
the eye enters and travels left, where the mooring line in the lower-left
catches it before it slides out of frame.

text.zhHant:
・防波堤：由左下往右上，與黃金螺旋的收斂方向一致
・桅杆：唯一的垂直線，用來斷開整片水平的海面
・雲的縫隙：把光帶到船身上，構成第二個亮點
text.en:
- Breakwater: lower-left to upper-right, following the spiral's convergence
- Mast: the only vertical, breaking an otherwise horizontal sea
- Gap in the cloud: carries light onto the hull, the second bright point

text.zhHant:
地平線壓在正中間了，少了 1/3 的張力。下次往下壓一格，
讓天空占 2/3，雲的層次才吃得到。
text.en:
The horizon ended up dead centre, which costs the frame its tension.
Next time drop it one step so the sky takes two thirds and the cloud
structure has room to read.

text.zhHant: （對到哪一個交點？視線怎麼走？）
text.en: (Which intersection does it land on? How does the eye travel?)

6|DC-V2-026|Release catch|1|POM

text.zhHant:
4 → 5（下）→ 3 → 2 → 5（上）→ 1 → 6
密封圈先套在集塵桶的溝槽裡再壓濾芯，反過來會把圈推歪而漏氣。
text.en:
4 -> 5 (lower) -> 3 -> 2 -> 5 (upper) -> 1 -> 6
Seat the seals in the bin groove before the element goes in; the other way round pushes them out of the groove and the unit leaks.

text.zhHant: 爆炸圖的間距要一致（這裡是 15 mm），不然讀圖的人會以為間距大的那一段是「裝不進去」。
text.en: Keep the explode spacing uniform (15 mm here). Uneven gaps read as "this part does not fit".

text.zhHant:

- Unknown account: never say "no such account"; always "if it exists, we sent it"
- Offline: top banner, and do not discard what has been typed

text.zhHant: 使用者旅程：第一次申請退款
對象：買錯尺寸的一般消費者　　情境：收到商品後 2 天　　目標：退款成功並知道錢什麼時候回來
text.en:
Persona: a shopper who ordered the wrong size    Context: two days after delivery
Goal: get the refund and know when the money comes back

text.zhHant:
階段|使用者在做什麼|想什麼|情緒|痛點
①察覺|試穿發現太小|「可以退嗎？」|中性|退貨條件寫在頁尾
②尋找|在訂單頁找退貨入口|「按鈕在哪？」|↓ 挫折|入口藏在「更多」裡
③申請|填原因、上傳照片|「要拍幾張？」|↓ 不確定|沒說最少幾張
④等待|等審核通知|「到底過了沒？」|↓↓ 最低點|三天沒有任何通知
⑤寄回|列印單子、交寄|「運費誰付？」|中性|運費說明在另一頁
⑥退款|收到入帳簡訊|「終於」|↑ 回升|
text.en:
Stage|What they do|What they think|Mood|Pain
1 Notice|Tries it on, too small|"Can I return this?"|Neutral|Policy is in the footer
2 Find|Looks for returns in the order page|"Where is the button?"|Down|Buried under "More"
3 Submit|Picks a reason, uploads photos|"How many photos?"|Down|Minimum never stated
4 Wait|Waits for approval|"Has it gone through?"|Lowest|Three days, no word
5 Ship back|Prints the label, drops it off|"Who pays postage?"|Neutral|Postage is on another page
6 Refunded|Gets the credit notification|"At last"|Up|
The one stage to fix first

text.zhHant:
第④段。它是情緒最低點，而且修起來最便宜 —— 一封「已收到，最慢 X 日前回覆」
的通知信就能把它拉起來，不需要動到流程。
text.en:
Stage 4. It is the low point and it is the cheapest to fix: one "received, you will
hear from us by X" message lifts it without touching the process at all.
